hits.draft_en:
Every creative career is just a pile of finished things.

Not ideas. Not drafts. Not 'someday.'

Finished, shipped, sold.

The market can't buy what you never let go of.
hits.video_tip: 15s talking-head, one take, hand-held. Hold up a finished thing (book, print, product) on the last line. Burn captions large.

hits.name: Codie_Sanchez
hits.text: You need to become addicted to finishing what you started.
hits.hook: You need to become addicted to finishing what you started.
hits.draft_en:
Hot take: selling your work isn't the opposite of art.

It's the last step of it.

A song nobody hears, a dinner nobody's invited to, a product nobody buys — all unfinished.

Make it. Then make the ask.
hits.video_tip: Open on the word 'Hot take' on screen; cut to you at your desk/studio. 3 jump cuts max, end with a direct-to-camera 'make the ask'.

hits.text: Entrepreneurship is trading years of your life to find out which of your ideas were good.
hits.hook: Entrepreneurship is trading years of your life to find out which of your ideas were good.
hits.draft_en:
AI made making cheap.

So what's expensive now?

• taste
• trust
• a room of 12 people who actually showed up for you

Build those. The tools will keep changing. Your people won't.
hits.video_tip: Screen-record a 3s AI generation, then hard cut to a real table/gathering photo or clip. Text overlay of the 3 bullets, one per beat.
